page.title: Remote servers
page.description: Other MCP servers whose tools pass through to your agents at the same address.

signIn.finish: Finish signing in on the page that opened in your browser. This page updates by itself.
signIn.refreshNeeded: The server no longer accepts the sign-in. Connect again to keep using it.
signIn.connectHint: Connect to sign in on the vendor's site. The tokens stay in this computer's secret store.
signIn.badLink: The sign-in link the daemon returned is not an http(s) address.

notMountable.setKey: Set its key first to turn it on.
notMountable.cannotEnable: It cannot be turned on yet.

fileError.title: Your servers file has a problem
fileError.before: None of your own servers connect until it is fixed:

packsEmpty.title: No pack offers a server
packsEmpty.body: Packs can bring ready-made servers. Turn on a pack on the Keys & packs page to see them here.

userEmpty.title: No servers of your own yet
userEmpty.before: Add any MCP server you use, remote or a program on this computer, with

add.title: Add your own MCP server
add.description: Its tools appear next to the others, named with the prefix you choose.

hints.id: Used in links and key names.
hints.url: To use a key, write ${secret:NAME} and set the key after adding.
hints.command: A program name on your PATH, or a full path.
hints.args: Separated by spaces. Use quotes to keep spaces inside one argument.

errors.name: Give it a name.
errors.id: Use 2 to 32 lowercase letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter.
errors.url: Enter an http or https address.
errors.exists: A server with this id already exists. Pick another id.

stdioWarning.title: This runs a program on your computer
stdioWarning.body: plughive starts it with your user's permissions. Only add programs you trust.

removeDialog.title: Remove {name}?
removeDialog.body: Its tools disappear from your agents. Keys you set for it stay stored until you remove them.

smart.title: Smart mount
smart.summary: Turned-on servers add about {tokens} tokens of tool definitions to your agents. Acting on the suggestions below saves about {reclaimable}.

modeHint.suggest: Servers and tools you have not used for a while are listed here. Nothing changes until you act on them.
modeHint.auto: Servers unused for the number of days below are parked (switched off) by themselves, once an hour. Switch one back on below at any time.

smart.idleDays: Park after this many days unused
smart.nothing: Every server that is on was used recently. Nothing to change.

reason.heavy: About {tokens} tokens of definitions for {calls} calls in 30 days.
reason.failing: It is on but cannot connect, so its tools never reach your agents.
reason.overlap: Does the same job as {with}, which got {withCalls} calls to its {calls} in 30 days.
reason.profile_unused: Other profiles use it; profile “{profile}” never did.

unused_tools.one: Profile “{profile}” never calls {count} of its tools: {tools}.
unused_tools.other: Profile “{profile}” never calls {count} of its tools: {tools}.

reason.search_mode: Every turn in profile “{profile}” carries its full tool list. Auto mode serves it through search instead.
reason.sign_in: It is on but signed out. Sign in again in its card below.
reason.missing_key: It is on but needs {secrets}. Set it in its card below.
reason.failing_tool: {tool} failed {percent}% of its {calls} calls this week. Check its key, sign-in or plan.

smart.parkedList: Parked: {names}. Switch one on below to use it again.

wake.label: When an agent asks for a parked tool

wakeHint.auto: Agents still find parked tools with search. Calling one switches its server back on by itself.
wakeHint.ask: Agents still find parked tools with search, and are told to ask you before switching the server back on.

smart.changesAria: Profile changes made by smart mount
smart.week: Last {days} days: {parked} parked, {woken} brought back, {hidden} hidden. Now saving about {tokens} tokens a turn.
